name: Sepolia smart contract
kernel: a Solidity contract deployed to Ethereum Sepolia via MetaMask private key, then verified on Etherscan
ui: a 'verified onchain' badge with the live contract address and an Etherscan link

name: IPFS via Pinata
kernel: a Pinata JWT upload that pins images / JSON / manifests to IPFS and returns a permanent CID
ui: a 'pinned to IPFS' chip with the CID and an ipfs.io gateway preview

name: Privy social + sponsored tx
kernel: Privy embedded wallet bootstrapped with PRIVY_APP_ID — Google sign-in plus sponsored transactions so users never see gas
ui: a one-click 'Sign in with Google' that drops the user straight into the app with an onchain identity

name: NFT provenance mint
kernel: an ERC-721 contract on Sepolia that mints a creator-owned token pointing at an IPFS CID, verified on Etherscan
ui: a 'mint to claim authorship' button that returns the tokenId, owner address, and Etherscan link
